# Azure DevOps MCP Server in .NET

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server built with .NET 8+ that integrates with Azure DevOps.

## Key Features

1. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk for MCP integration
2. Azure DevOps .NET SDK (Microsoft.TeamFoundationServer.Client & Azure.DevOps)
3. C# 8+ with nullable reference types
4. FluentValidation + DataAnnotations for input validation
5. Serilog + Polly for logging & resilience
6. NUnit/xUnit + Moq for unit testing
7. CI/CD via GitHub Actions & SonarCloud
